name: Attendance By Project
query:
SELECT 
    eam.project AS "Project:Link/Project Setup:150",
    ps.project__object_name AS "Project Name::200",
    eam.employee AS "Employee:Link/Employee:150",
    eam.full_name AS "Employee Name::200",
    COUNT(eam.name) AS "Total Days Present:Int:100",
    eam.team_leader AS "Team Leader:Link/User:150",
    eam.tl_name AS "Team Leader Name::200"
FROM `tabEmployee Attendance Master` eam
LEFT JOIN `tabProject Setup` ps ON eam.project = ps.name
WHERE eam.present = 'Yes'
GROUP BY eam.project, ps.project__object_name, eam.employee, eam.full_name, eam.team_leader, eam.tl_name
ORDER BY eam.project, COUNT(eam.name) DESC;
